status: PROPOSED (needs the owner's approval before any other data depends on it)
axes: x east, z north, y up: the game's route axes
projection: local tangent plane: x = (lon - lon0) * 111320 * cos(lat0), z = (lat - lat0) * 110700; error below 0.1% within 25 km

anchor.name: Kano city reference point
anchor.source: Wikipedia 'Kano (city)': 12°00'N 8°31'E (about +-1 km; to be replaced by a surveyed reference)

chunkLattice.note: All Kano authored coordinates are multiples of 200 m at chunk corners so neighbouring routes share the game's chunk lattice (ChunkStreamer.chunkSize).

slice.note: About 4 km south-west of the reference point on the Kaduna approach direction. A design choice, not a survey: no street here is a real street.

qibla.note: Great-circle initial bearing Kano -> Mecca, computed from 12.0N 8.5167E and 21.4225N 39.8262E. Mosques in the slice orient their qibla wall to this, whatever the road does.

worldMapDiscrepancy.note: The world map's Kano longitude (8.592) is about 8 km east of the Wikipedia reference (8.5167). Not changed; the owner decides which is authoritative.
